attributes.action: Change the section under the Children Act 1989 loophole to remove a children
attributes.additional_details: Childrens social services stealing children from loving families using the section off a child might at risk off neglect
attributes.background: I would like the laws changing childrens social services using loopholes to steal children they must remove their might be a risk off harm and neglect section has childrens social services are abusing this up and down the country to get removal orders on loving families

rejection.details:
We are not sure exactly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.

There is no legal "loophole" in the Children Act 1989 that allows a person or the Local Authority to remove a child unlawfully.

You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/762604
